title: Rewrite ConnectivityGateway's only test — it is tautologically true and hits the real network
rule: TQ-6 (hermetic tests: no network) + TQ-8 (assertion weaker than what the source can do wrong)
why: isOffline is defined as the literal negation of isOnline, so expect(online, isNot(offline)) reduces to 'online == online' — true for every possible return value, including if isOnline were hardcoded to `return true;`. The test can never catch a regression in the actual DNS-lookup logic. Because ConnectivityGateway has no injectable seam for the lookup, the test cannot fake a response either way and instead performs a live DNS query to dns.google on every run — flaky/slow/blocked in network-restricted CI or sandboxes, and this is the class's only test.
recommendation: Add an injectable lookup function (e.g. `Future<List<InternetAddress>> Function(String)`, defaulting to InternetAddress.lookup) to ConnectivityGateway, then test both the true and false paths via a fake with zero real network access.
acceptance_criteria: test asserts isOnline == true for a faked successful lookup and == false for a faked SocketException/timeout
test suite passes with network access disabled
